# Resomi
Resomi are a small, feathered, avian-like species that hail from an icy world. Their slight frame means most clothing is tailored down to fit them.
## Diet
- Like most other non-human species, Resomi can digest raw meat and other uncooked animal proteins.
## Benefits
- Thanks to their frozen home world and ammonia-based blood, Resomi [color=#1e90ff]tolerate cold down to around -60°C, take 30% less Cold damage and are slowed by the cold later than most species.[/color] Vacuum and deep freezes will still kill them. - Their unarmed attack deals [color=#ec3a3a]Slash[/color] damage.
## Drawbacks
- Temperatures most species find comfortable are close to unbearable for them; they [color=#ffa500]start burning up at around 47°C.[/color] - They [color=#ffa500]take 30% more Heat damage and 15% more Blunt, Slash and Piercing damage.[/color] - Resomi have [color=#ffa500]a third less blood[/color] than most species, so blood loss catches up with them much sooner. - Their ammonia-based blood means standard blood transfusions won't help them. - They weigh less than most species.
## Voice
Resomi speak in clicks and chirps, and can [color=#1e90ff]*chirp*, *trill*, *warble* and *wurble*.[/color]
